questions.prompt: You type: `true; false; echo $?` — what prints?
A script ends without any explicit exit. Its exit code is…

options.b: the exit code of the last command it ran

questions.prompt: Why do hardened scripts write `if grep -q ERROR log` instead of running grep and then testing `[ $? -eq 0 ]`?

options.a: purely style — the two are identical in every way
options.b: if cmd reads the code directly, leaving no window for another command to overwrite $?
